author: noelkimx
text: A function name the model picks is untrusted input. Agno's PandasTools passed it to getattr, so a prompt injection could make the agent call read_pickle on an attacker's file and run code (CVE-2026-119050). I'd grep my tools for getattr on those names and allowlist each hit.
